{{Top|leg}}
The '''Department of System Exploration''' was a department within the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] since at least its [[Declaration of a New Order|inception]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]. Although it technically was supposed to oversee [[Star system/Legends|system]] explorations, funds that were earmarked for the department were instead funneled, as with the [[Department of Public Works]], to the development of both the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]] and the [[Dreadnaught/Legends|superdreadnought]] ''[[Eye of Palpatine]]'' under the orders of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] [[Gender/Legends|himself]].
